canonical: Distinguish policy coverage, legal eligibility and actual courier supply. Travel presence must combine qualified provider availability with applicable policy visibility, privacy thresholds and expiry.
requirements: qualified, current, nonrevoked actual provider availability
privacy cohort threshold and redacted public response
expiry bounded by provider and reviewed policy; fail closed on provider or policy outage
limitations: Synthetic policy and supply adapters cannot prove production legal approval or live provider availability
Independently authorized Travel and DOOBr consumers deferred to C09/C10
next_canonical: C05.8 — Oracle integration suitability review and narrowly scoped adapter where required; preserve canonical runtime ABI and reporting-only authority. Off-chain source monitoring need not become an oracle feed.
